documented_expected_divergences: mortality_p4.CroDam: known_divergent_scenario_scoped — mort_crcabe vs the manifested mortality golden's prob across 29 CroDam scenarios covering all eleven sr_EFR PFI equations (fof_mrt.cpp:78-91) at both crown-damage endpoints, plus beetle on/off, a zero cambium-kill rating, and ValidInput's four density boundary rows. The oracle became available when schema v2 added the density_tpa column that ValidInput requires (F-45, resolved). Eight equations agree - SF, WL, IC, ES, RF, SP, PP, PK - with a measured maximum |diff| of 4.51e-07 among them, below the golden's six-decimal fmt(prob, 6) resolution, which is why the atol is 1e-06. Three diverge and are strict xfails under F-50 (WF, WP, DF): each is an equation with a DBH term whose Python coefficient is a ROUNDED centimetre conversion of the pinned per-inch value (0.0483/2.54 = 0.019016 vs 0.019; -0.1232/2.54 = -0.048504 vs -0.0485; -0.0788/2.54 = -0.031024 vs -0.031 and 0.1251/2.54 = 0.049252 vs 0.0492). Measured |diff| 1.43e-06 to 2.08e-04. The smallest divergence, 1.43e-06, is 1.4x the atol and 3.2x the largest agreement, so the atol separates the two populations without absorbing any defect. Same defect class as F-47 on the crown-scorch side. (gate0/04-findings.md:F-45 (resolved), F-50; gate0/07-branch-traceability.csv BR-MRT-CD-WF .. mortality_p4.CroSco: known_divergent_scenario_scoped — mort_crnsch vs the manifested mortality golden's prob across 23 scenarios covering MRT_Calc cases 1, 3, 4, 5, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20 and 21. The scenarios retain manifest-supplied bark inputs to isolate the mortality equations, while the F-19 repair separately verifies Python's complete 525-code bark lookup and its omitted-bark default contract. Nineteen scenarios agree, including the case-3 exact-1-inch boundary after Python adopted C++'s complete small-tree branch, all three flame-driven Black Hills ponderosa pine size classes, and case 4's high-severity row after direct FOFEM Calc_Scorch and the Aspen char-height metre-to-centimetre conversion were added; their measured maximum difference is 5.4e-07. Three actual defects remain strict xfails: 1 under F-49 (the Longleaf crown-scorch scale) and 2 under F-47 (rounded centimetre conversions of per-inch DBH coefficients). The remaining case-4 low-severity strict xfail is F-46 RESOLVED behavior: C++'s legacy Calc_Scorch-to-Calc_Flame round trip changes a supplied flame slightly, while Python deliberately preserves it; the measured 5.68e-05 probability difference is documented, not a Python defect. (gate0/04-findings.md:F-46, F-47, F-48 (resolved), F-49; gate0/07-branch-traceability.csv BR-MRT-CS-01, BR-MRT-CS-03, BR-MRT-CS-04, BR-MRT-CS-05, BR-MRT-CS-10 ..
